checks.must: Keeps the acceptance test's settled() working: uses Ember run-loop timers or registers a test waiter (@ember/test-waiters) for setTimeout, or explicitly flags that the test will break and updates it.
Ember callers can still call toasts.show(text, ms) with the same signature and 4000 ms default.
Clicking dismisses and cancels the timer (no late double-removal).
The React stack re-renders when Ember code calls show() (subscription/useSyncExternalStore or tracked bridge).
Timers are cleared and React root unmounted on app/service teardown (important in tests).
No unrequested behaviour changes without calling them out.
